title: 第15章 截教内门弟子定共邀内门弟子议事第16章 千里之坝溃于蚁穴青渊入金仙
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 秀丽山河上空。
清幽峰道场之外，大量截教门人遥望着天上玄衣身影，心神震撼。
他们曾以为门内除多宝师兄外，再无人可担任截教首徒，但今日一看多宝师兄也要逊色于此人啊！
不过也是。
听闻此人早在老师未成圣之时便跟随数百万年。
怎会无本领傍身？
正当众多门人恍惚之余，天地间回荡着威严神圣的声音：“青渊、多宝、金灵、无当，且入上清宫中，其他人速速散去。”
“老师？”
所有截教门人一惊，连忙恭敬跪拜。
青渊、多宝等人亦是遵行大礼，等那股浩瀚圣威消失，方才起身一同结伴前去。
“青师兄，您说老师唤我等前去为何？”
无当圣母面露好奇。
“我也不知。”
青渊内心虽然有些猜测，却没有把答案说出来。
多宝道人想到了什么，脸色有些黯淡。
随后，一行人来到上清宫外，待殿外拜见得到同意后方才一同入了殿内。
殿内装饰简朴。
只见蒲团上盘坐着面容英俊的青年，顶上金光分五彩，一身青衣蕴紫气。
纵然没有刻意显露，但举手投足蕴含着磅礴浩瀚的滚滚天威，不怒自威，令人心生敬畏。
“拜见老师！”
四人恭敬跪拜。
“嗯，起来吧。”
通天教主点了点头，面色平静的注视着青渊良久，方道：“徒儿，恭喜你，你寻到了自己的道。”
“自己的道？”
青渊内心有些好奇。
不知道老师说的道是不是悟出的剑道、阵道、丹道之流？
虽不解，但还是躬身恭声道：“多谢老师厚爱。”
“修行当持道，唯有了自己的道，方才能在洪荒中走的长远，原本你我并无师徒缘分，多宝、金灵、无当皆悟出了自己的道，而你一直来迷茫懵懂，但终究陪伴为师多年，关于内门弟子一事为师亦是有些迟疑，好在你悟出己道，截留住了自身的一线机缘，为师正式收你为弟子又如何呢。”
通天教主面露微笑，淡淡道：“青渊。”
“弟子在！”
“从今日起，你正式为本座门下内门大弟子、截教首徒，赐你上品先天灵宝阴阳两仪灯，吾观你练入溺水本源入化神通，但独阴不生，赐你此宝，望你能够领悟阴阳补全五行，切勿忘了五行之重要。”
“弟子多谢师父！”
content_en:
The sky above the beautiful mountains and rivers.
Outside the Qingyou Peak Dojo, a large number of Jie Jiao disciples were shocked as they looked at Xuan Yi's figure in the sky.
They once thought that no one else in the sect except Senior Brother Duobao could serve as the leader of the Jiejiao Cult, but today it seems that Senior Brother Duobao is inferior to this person!
But yes.
I heard that this person had been following the teacher for millions of years before he became a saint.
How could you be so helpless?
While many disciples were in a trance, a majestic and sacred voice echoed between heaven and earth: "Qingyuan, Duobao, Jinling, Wudang, please enter the Shangqing Palace, and the others will disperse quickly."
"Teacher?"
All the Jie Jiao disciples were shocked and quickly knelt down respectfully.
Qingyuan, Duobao and others also followed the great ceremony and waited for the vast holy power to disappear before they got up and went together.
"Senior Brother Qing, why do you think the teacher called me to wait?"
The Virgin Mother looked curious.
"I don't know either."
Although Qingyuan had some guesses in his heart, he did not tell the answer.
Taoist Duobao thought of something and his face turned a little gloomy.
Afterwards, the group of people came to the outside of the Shangqing Palace. After receiving permission from the audience outside the palace, they entered the palace together.
The decoration inside the temple is simple.
I saw a young man with a handsome face sitting cross-legged on the futon. The golden light on his head was divided into five colors, and his green clothes were filled with purple energy.
Even though it is not deliberately revealed, the majestic and vast rolling power of God is contained in every gesture, and it is self-powerful without anger, which is awe-inspiring.
"Meet the teacher!"
The four of them knelt down respectfully.
"Well, get up."
Leader Tongtian nodded, looked at Qingyuan calmly for a long time, and said, "Disciple, congratulations, you have found your own way."
"My own way?"
Qingyuan was a little curious in his heart.
I wonder if the Tao the teacher is talking about is the Tao of Swordsmanship, Formation Tao, and Alchemy Tao?
Although he was puzzled, he still bowed and said respectfully: "Thank you teacher for your kindness."
"You should practice and uphold the Tao. Only by having your own Tao can you go far in the wilderness. Originally, you and I were not destined to be masters and disciples. Duobao, Jinling, and Wudang all realized their own Tao. You have always been confused and ignorant, but after all, you have been with me as a teacher for many years. You are also a little hesitant about becoming an inner disciple. Fortunately, you have realized your own way and captured your own chance. So what if I officially accept you as a disciple."
The leader of Tongtian Cult smiled and said calmly: "Qingyuan."
"The disciple is here!"
"From today on, you are officially the first disciple of the inner sect and the first disciple of the Jie Cult. I will give you the highest quality innate spiritual treasure, the Yin and Yang Yin Yin Lamp. I see that you have mastered the supernatural power of drowning, but only Yin cannot arise. I give you this treasure. I hope you can understand that Yin and Yang complement the five elements. Don't forget the importance of the five elements."
"Disciple, thank you Master!"
title_en: Chapter 15: The inner disciples of the Jiejiao will invite the inner disciples to discuss matters Chapter 16: The Dam of Thousand Miles Bursts in the Ant Nest, Qingyuan, and Enters the Golden Immortal
